about: Graphics cards the tensor-rate unlock is offered on (gpuunlock, Settings > Power > Graphics card). Exact matches only: device, board (subsystem), VBIOS and driver series. No wildcards. The method is nlzy/turing-unlock's kernel module (Labyrinth OS docs/GPU_UNLOCK.md, section 12): an entry needs runs on the same chip and VBIOS family, starts as experimental, and nothing is kept before the owner's own supervised run.

entries.evidence: https://github.com/nlzy/turing-unlock/issues (TU102 2080 Ti reports #1, #2, PR #8 incl. VBIOS 90.02.17.00.7C and .64; #5 on driver 615.78.08, kernel 7.3, as the boot display)
entries.notes: MSI RTX 2080 Ti (the owner's card). No MSI board in the reports yet: Phase 3 on this card is the first.
